tokenizer.conclusion: All three extra quotes are present in generated ordinary token IDs (14937 is { followed by quote, then 107 newline, 138 indentation, 236775 another quote). HF/native detokenization agrees exactly. This excludes detokenization/escaping or vocabulary-ID conversion as their cause, but does not distinguish model-weight behavior from denoising/sampler differences.

nativeEog.method: Native llama-vocab.cpp recognizes these token strings as EOG and removes </s> when <|tool_response> is present; tokenizer metadata IDs verified above.

tokenizer.encodingNote: hfInputTokenIds are CPU HF token IDs using native explicit BOS convention; hfRawInputTokenIds are raw tokenizers.Tokenizer.encode(..., add_special_tokens=True), which does not add BOS for this tokenizer.json. Token ID 2 is the official HF BOS and native GGUF BOS.

hfBosHandling.explanation: HF processor apply_chat_template supplies BOS through chat_template.jinja, while native rendered prompt omits it and GGUF add_bos_token=true prepends it. Explicitly prefixing id 2 to the saved native prompt reproduces that shared convention.

entropyReference.scope: Model-free CPU numerical reference only. No model weights, generation, accelerator queries or GPU operations.

fixture.construction: float32 log(float32(9e-10)); one peak processed logit=0, all remaining processed logits=tailProcessedLogitFloat32
fixture.canvasNote: One identical argmax token submitted twice to official stopping criterion. Repeating this same row across a canvas gives the same mathematical mean entropy.

method.nativeArithmetic: Emulates diffusion.cpp float32 exp terms, sequential Z accumulation, float32 p=e/Z, float32 -p*log(p), and sequential H accumulation using NumPy cumsum(dtype=float32). This is not an execution of the compiled C++ helper; exp/log library rounding may differ slightly.
method.nativeSequentialAccumulation: NumPy cumsum performs the ordered accumulation; NumPy sum is intentionally not used for native Z or H.
method.analyticDouble: Z=1+(N-1)*exp(float32_tail_logit); H=log(Z)-((N-1)*exp(float32_tail_logit)/Z)*float32_tail_logit, evaluated with Python double math.
method.officialTorch: Installed torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=scores).entropy() and installed Transformers StableAndConfidentStoppingCriteria called twice with an unchanged argmax canvas; tensors explicitly on CPU.

entropyReference.conclusion: Sequential float32 accumulation introduces vocabulary-order dependence and can cross the configured confidence threshold and change entropy-bound acceptance. The official CPU criterion continues on this fixture. This numerical defect is not yet proven to cause the observed extra-quote failures; native compiled and live-prompt before/after comparisons remain separate tests.
